parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the two test methods `radioPlayerStopCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 37) and `radioPlayerStopResetsStream` (line 53) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.818), they are distinct test cases verifying different observable behaviours of the stop action — one asserts delegation to the underlying player, the other asserts stream-reset side effects. Collapsing them would obscure failure attribution and violate the single-assertion-per-test principle common in XCTest suites.
